notes.title: QUEST LOG HOTFIX
notes.content:
Version 1.02.01

Fixed a minor bug that made the quest log update incorrectly showing main quests were done while player was hunting Rapati Raptors. Now the quest is updated correctly.

notes.title: Bug Fix Patch 2
notes.content:
Bug Fixing Patch 2

Game Version 1.02

- Fixed a Bug where sometimes an incorrect autosave occurred, softlocking the player from entering Emoru "The Wacko" fight arena.
- Fixed a bug in which the game progress percentage showed at the save file text wasn't reflecting the actual in-game percentage (Overwriting the save file is required for the number to refresh).
- Fixed a bug that happened sometimes when scrolling through the gallery pictures the game would crash.

notes.title: Bio-Pack Bug Fix Patch 1
notes.content:
Some players reported the game crashing when interacting with the Bio-pack printer in Kouia's Room. The Bio-Pack function is an incomplete feature that couldn't be included into Steam due copyright reasons. The quest text has been changed and the bio-Pack isn't interactible anymore.
If you have any leftover Bio-Packs in your inventory you can safely sell it to gain Zeons.
